evasion_instruction_findings.rationale: Using terms like 'Cookies de Evasión' in executive dashboards conveys illicit hacking rather than deterministic marketplace monitoring. It belongs strictly in an admin/technical operations view.

evasion_instruction_findings.text_snippet: Guía de Ayuda Rápida: ¿Cómo actualizar las cookies en 1 minuto? ... Instala la Extensión Cookie Editor ... Exporta en Formato JSON ... Pega y Haz Clic en Actualizar
evasion_instruction_findings.rationale: Manual browser extension instructions for evading Cloudflare blocks distract executives and clutter commercial decision screens.

recommendation: In the upcoming dashboard redesign (VA-EXECUTIVE-DASHBOARD-REDESIGN-001), move all session cookie controls, extension tutorials, and bypass instructions to a separate, dedicated 'Configuración Técnica / Operaciones' tab, completely isolated from the Executive and Analytical commercial views.
